args.message:
Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money previously used ROUND_HALF_UP, which broke tests/test_money.py
(the nightly build). This switches the quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
half-way cent amounts round to the nearest even cent, per FIN-212.

args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` by implementing banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) in `src/money.py`, per FIN-212.

## Root cause
`round_money` claimed to use banker's rounding per FIN-212 in its docstring, but actually quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The test `test_half_even` asserts that midway cent amounts (e.g. `2.665`) round to the nearest **even** cent (`2.66`), so it failed under `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
Changed the rounding mode passed to `Decimal.quantize` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

```
Decimal("2.675") -> 2.68
Decimal("2.665") -> 2.66   # banker's rounding, matches FIN-212
```

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch (commit `08d3cd5986`): **passed**

Merging into main requires code owner approval per org policy — @code-owner please review/approve so this can ship in today's release.

Closes FIN-212
